content.title: Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival
content.text: If you are using a screen reader and are having problems using this website, please call (888) 226-0076 for assistance. Please note, this number is for accessibility issues and is not a ticketing hotline. How The Waitlist Works Click “Join Waitlist” Choose your passes/items. If inventory frees up, you’ll be charged in full automatically, and they’re yours! Once you know what you’re getting yourself into, let’s get this party rolling! General Info The waitlist will open for items as they are sold out. Orders are filled “first come, first served”. There is no way to see your place in line. Completing a waitlist request DOES NOT guarantee passes or camping for the event and are subject to availability. Pricing & Deposits Waitlist pricing for items is 'dynamic' and adjusts according to market supply & demand. Your waitlist order total will display based on your selected items. Once you submit your request your price will not change. If/once your waitlist request becomes fulfilled, your selected payment method will be charged automatically the remaining balance of your order. Each waitlist item type requires a $20 deposit (Example 4 admission passes + 1 car camping pass x $20 deposit each type) = $40 deposit. If your order is fulfilled, your deposit will apply to the order total. If your order can’t be filled, your deposit will be refunded 7–10 after the festival concludes. There are no payment plan options for waitlist orders. Checking Order Status & Notifications You’ll be sent an email from AXS if your order is fulfilled. Be sure to check your order status in your Coachella FanAccount. Coachella/AXS is not responsible for failed, blocked, misdelivered or bounced email delivery. It's your responsibility to make sure your payment method is valid, has sufficient funds and is not expired. Credit card is recommended over debit card. There is no notification upon a failed charge attempt. Failed charge attempts may or may not be tried again at a later date. You will lose your place in line. You may lose your chance for fulfillment. Waitlist Request Cancellation To leave the waitlist, cancel your request(s) via Coachella fanAccount. You must cancel any request you do not want fulfilled. There are no reversals of orders once fulfilled (ie. once the order is charged in full). Important Details & Reminders Don’t sign up multiple times for the same item—it will not improve your odds. There are strict order limits. Review the Ordering Info & Rules to ensure your order is not canceled! Your order will be filled only if inventory is available for every item in your order. $16 postage and shipping fee per order added at check out. (Domestic or International shipping). All sales are final. Orders cannot be canceled or changed once they’re processed. Waitlist / Order Support / Help For help with your Waitlist request/order, please contact AXS order support. Live Chat Available! Mon - Fri: 8am-10pm CST Sat & Sun: 12pm-10pm CST
